comparisonMeaning: Concept 7F is a documentation-only audit. The after state means the product evidence is now documented; it does not mean Concept 7G or any UI change was implemented.

before.productShell: Existing map-first single-page shell with Plan, Simulate, Analyze, Review rail and contextual drawer.
before.lineageVisibility: Project visible globally; Scenario/Version mostly visible in Project menu and Setup; Run/Report lineage visible in Review details.
before.staleCommunication: RF-affecting edits invalidate rendered results and show Plan changed / Run guidance.
before.drawerDensity: Setup, Propagation, RF Diagnostics, and Data combine core and specialized/research content.
before.responsiveEvidence: 1440px/1280px usable; 1024px crowded; 640px best-effort bottom-sheet map layout with layer-menu overflow.
before.bundleEvidence: One main JS chunk with Vite >500 kB warning.

after.productShell: Same application shell; documented as global, project, Scenario, map, Run, and Report ownership.
after.lineageVisibility: Gap documented and made the selected Concept 7G target; no header or panel behavior changed.
after.staleCommunication: Existing invalidation behavior documented as safe but incomplete; Current/Stale/Historical vocabulary proposed for a future phase.
after.drawerDensity: Overload and research-boundary evidence documented; no panels merged or moved.
after.responsiveEvidence: Representative width findings recorded with realistic support boundary; no CSS changed.
after.bundleEvidence: Generated sizes and source-level eager-load candidates recorded; no dynamic imports added.
after.productDecision: Concept 7G — Results, Lineage & Stale-State UX selected.

stopCondition: After the listed validations pass or any failure is recorded with its cause, stop Concept 7F. Do not implement the selected Concept 7G in this task.
